description:
Returns a list of [[getPlayerID|player ids]] of all the users on an MP server.
{{Feature|informative|This also lists [[Arma 3: Headless Client|Headless Clients]].}}
examples:
<sqf>
if (isServer) then
{
	private _allUserIDs = allUsers;
	for "_i" from 0 to (count _allUserIds - 1) do
	{
		diag_log format ["User #%1 ID: %2", _i + 1, _allUserIds select _i];
	};
};
</sqf>
name: allUsers
